name: Man of Sterling Quality
source:
This is the heartwarming story of Booth Preacher Jim, the Man of Sterling Quality.

Jim is a tremendous man who is big and strong and manly. Everyone knows it, even if his critics pretend otherwise. To be completely honest, they are all just jealous and have much wickedness in their evil hearts because they are nowhere near as masculine as Jim. Their small petty minds cannot comprehend Jim's huge heart that is always ready to help people, whether they want it or not.

His booth always appears where it is most needed. Unsuspecting pedestrians and commuters alike benefit from Jim's wise counsel as he screams unspecified sermons at them with a vociferous virile voice.

But his noble routine has been disrupted. An ancient Steam Greenlight game has finally been released from the depths of Early Access and now runs rampant throughout the internet. Anyone unfortunate enough to play 'Death Simulator' will summon forth the mysterious Evil Ghost in seven days... Unfortunately for Evil Ghost, her womanly ways will prove insufficient to overcome the mighty male maestro that is Jim.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是布斯传教士吉姆（Booth Preacher Jim）的感人故事，他是一位品质一流的人。

吉姆是一个了不起的人，高大、强壮、有男子气概。每个人都知道这一点，即使他的批评者假装不这么认为。老实说，他们都只是嫉妒，内心邪恶，因为他们远没有吉姆那么阳刚。他们狭隘的头脑无法理解吉姆那颗伟大的心，他随时准备帮助人们，无论他们愿意与否。

他的展位总是出现在最需要的地方。毫无戒心的行人和通勤者都从吉姆明智的建议中受益，因为他用大声、阳刚的声音向他们尖叫着未具体说明的布道。

但他的高贵生活却被打乱了。一款古老的Steam青睐之光游戏终于从抢先体验的深处发布，现在在互联网上肆虐。任何不幸玩“死亡模拟器”的人都会在七天内召唤出神秘的恶鬼……不幸的是，对于恶鬼来说，她的女人味不足以战胜强大的男性大师吉姆。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851630/]Steam[/url]]
